beats.event: Gilgamesh rules Uruk as a tyrant, oppressing brides and youth
Gods create wild Enkidu as a rival; Shamhat civilizes him
Enkidu blocks the bridal chamber; the two heroes wrestle
Wrestling ends; Gilgamesh and Enkidu become devoted friends
They set out for the Cedar Forest to slay Humbaba
With Shamash's winds they kill Humbaba and take the cedars
Gilgamesh scorns Ishtar; she sends the Bull of Heaven
They kill the Bull of Heaven; Enkidu hurls its haunch at Ishtar
Gods condemn Enkidu to death for the killings
Enkidu wastes for twelve days and dies in torment
Gilgamesh wanders wilderness in animal skins, dreading death
Passes Mount Mashu's tunnel past scorpion guardians
Siduri counsels acceptance; Urshanabi ferries him across
Utnapishtim tells the flood, refuses to grant immortality
Retrieves the plant of youth from the ocean floor
A serpent steals the plant while he bathes
Returns to Uruk, praises the city walls, accepts mortality
